task.text:
[0] n=140-150 The significant increase in survival of male transgenic flies exposed to 12uM tunicamycin for 140h, a known ER stress inducer, when compared with control flies ( rank P = 0.0028) was observed.

[1] n=140-150 No lifespan extension was observed in female transgenic flies when treated with 12uM tunicamycin for 140h, when compared with control flies was observed.

[2] Under the acute oxidative stress condition induced by paraquat (20 mM in 5% sucrose for the next 108 h), male and female CYB5R-OE flies exhibited significant increase in survival relative to gender-matched controls.

[3] Under the acute oxidative stress condition induced by paraquat (20 mM in 5% sucrose for the next 108 h), male and female CYB5R-OE flies exhibited significant increase in survival relative to gender-matched controls.

[4] dhfr-1 knockdown in worms led to increased lifespan. Age was counted from stage L4. Suppl table 7, figure 2a.

[5] Dystrophin-deficient female mice displayed progressively dystrophic muscle histopathology, shorter lifespan, and were susceptible to spontaneous rhabdomyosarcoma.

[6] Dystrophin-deficient male mice displayed progressively dystrophic muscle histopathology, shorter lifespan, and were susceptible to spontaneous rhabdomyosarcoma.

[7] Females show qualitatively similar lifespan data, even though the extension of lifespan in pucE69 females is less pronounced than in males. p<0.001

[8] Knockdown of efl-1 (E2F1 ortholog) prolonged the lifespan of worms.

[9] Loss of function mutation of daf-16 (FOXO ortholog) canceled the life-extending effect of efl-1 (E2F1 ortholog) knockdown.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
